name: NeRF as an Auto-Decoder
definition: A multi-scene NeRF setup where per-scene codes {xi} and shared parameters ψ are jointly learned, treating the plenoptic function as a decoder and scene codes as latent codes with Gaussian priors.
summary: NeRF as an Auto-Decoder shares network parameters across multiple scenes while using per-scene latent codes, enabling unconditional 3D generation and single-view reconstruction without per-scene optimization.
